newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS BOURSE OKS ALUMINIUM OF ATTICA CONVERTIBLE.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS BOURSE OKS ALUMINIUM OF ATTICA CONVERTIBLE.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange approved Aluminium of Attica's 2.3 billion drachma convertible bond issue, it said on Thursday.
The convertible bonds which feature a floating rate mature in five years. They will be offered at 2,400 drachmas each.

Aluminium of Attica shareholders will be entitled to 40 bonds for every 300 shares outstanding. Proceeds will be used to pay down short term debt and to finance investments in equipment. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
